organic.title: Extending Multilingual Speech Synthesis to 100+ Languages ...
organic.snippet: Abstract Collecting high-quality studio recordings of audio is challenging, which limits the language coverage of text-to-speech (TTS) systems. This paper proposes a framework for scaling a multilingual TTS model to 100+ languages using found data without supervision. organic.title: Enhancing Indonesian Automatic Speech Recognition:
organic.snippet: In our approach, we used fine-tuning, a method where a pre-trained model is further trained (or fine-tuned) on a new dataset. Recently, the development of Indonesian ASR has focused on pre-trained multilingual models for both the Indonesian language [3, 4] and Indonesian ethnic languages [5], particularly with an emphasis on read and formal speech.
